name: perception
display_name: Detect objects of a known class
description: Runs a continuous object-detection stream for a requested object class, publishing detections (both 2D image-plane and 3D spatial) as feedback until the caller cancels the goal. This mock implementation only knows how to detect one class: cats ('gato'). Any goal that does not request that class is rejected outright.

goal.object_classes: string[] - object classes to look for. Must include 'gato' (case-insensitive substring match); any other request is rejected since this mock does not detect other classes.
goal.continuous: bool - accepted but not honored by this mock: every goal streams until canceled/preempted regardless of this flag.
goal.max_rate_hz: float32 - accepted but not honored by this mock: the fixed 'perception.detection_rate_hz' parameter is used instead.
goal.parameters_json: string - optional JSON escape hatch for stack-specific perception parameters; empty for defaults.

feedback.detections_3d: vision_msgs/Detection3DArray - 1 to 3 randomly placed 3D detections per message, published continuously while the goal is active.
feedback.detections_2d: vision_msgs/Detection2DArray - the same detections' 2D image-plane bounding boxes, published alongside detections_3d.

result.error_code: uint16 - 0 SUCCESS, 1 REJECTED, 2 ABORTED, 3 CANCELED, 4 TIMEOUT. CANCELED is the expected way this capability's goals end (this mock never completes on its own); ABORTED means the goal was preempted or the capability shut down.
result.error_msg: string - populated when error_code is not SUCCESS/CANCELED, explaining why.
result.detections_3d: vision_msgs/Detection3DArray - final detection snapshot; empty in this mock implementation.
result.detections_2d: vision_msgs/Detection2DArray - final detection snapshot; empty in this mock implementation.

requirements: The requested 'object_classes' list must include the target class this mock supports (default 'gato'); otherwise the goal is rejected immediately.
This action never completes on its own: it streams feedback indefinitely until the caller cancels the goal (or it is preempted by a new one).
effects: None on the physical world: this is a perception-only capability that reports detections, it does not act on them.
While a goal is active, detections_3d/detections_2d feedback is published at a steady rate (see 'perception.detection_rate_hz').

preemption.behavior_when_enabled: Sending a new goal while one is active aborts the previous goal (error_code=ABORTED) and starts detecting for the new request instead.
preemption.behavior_when_disabled: Sending a new goal while one is active is rejected outright; the caller must cancel the current goal first.

perception.allow_preemption.description: Whether a new perception goal is allowed to preempt (replace) one that is currently executing.

perception.target_class.description: The only object class this mock can 'detect'. A goal is only accepted if its 'objects' list contains this string (case-insensitive substring match).

perception.detection_rate_hz.description: Rate at which detections_3d/detections_2d feedback is published while a goal is active.

perception.frame_id.description: Frame id stamped on the published detections.

capabilities_file.description: Path to this very capability description file; published verbatim on /capabilities when the node is activated.

notes: This is a mock implementation, part of the EasyFleet architecture, standing in for a real perception stack (a classic detector, a VLM-based one, or otherwise) during integration testing of multi-capability systems. Detections are random placeholder positions, not derived from any sensor data.
